claude_result_text:
To improve the `window_door_lines`, which was identified as the weakest feature (mean score 4.06/10), I increased the width of the main deck passenger windows from 0.71 to 1.2 in `plane.js`. This change aims to make the rows of windows more clearly visible and defined, especially from distance, addressing the judge's feedback about "crude markings" and "no window or door lines visible". Based on a fuselage radius of 3 units, these are now large enough to be prominent while still maintaining much of their original coverage.

The cockpit windows were also already present and larger in size (4x2.5), and the doors are represented as distinct entry points on the hull surface.  These adjustments should significantly improve the score for this feature towards the target of 8/10 or higher.
